Hi Irene,

I signed up through the self-serve hosted API sandbox and poked around the quickstart. We’re evaluating options for embedding a summarization endpoint into our product roadmap and would like a short demo + Q&A focused on latency and embedding workflows.

Possible attendees from our side: me (product), Liam (engineer). We’re based in Dublin (GMT) and prefer mornings between 09:00–12:00 local. Are there 30-minute slots available this week?

I pasted a couple of notes on our use case below:
- 40–50 req/s for short summaries (avg 120 tokens)
- Req/resp latency SLO: 200–300ms target
- Data retention: short policy, no long-term storage for PII

Thanks — happy to be flexible.
